findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Observed no certified food manager to be present during inspection. Discussed with PIC, ensure a certified food manager is present within the facility during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Proper hot holding temperatures.
findings.comment: Observed chocolate sauces hot holding at 120F. Discussed with PIC, sauces were removed and reheated to 165F and returned to warmer. Ensure any TCS item being hot held is kept at or above 135F.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(1) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained: (1) At 57°C (135°F) or above, except that roasts cooked to a temperature and for a time specified in 3-401.11(B) or reheated as specified in 3-403.11(E) may be held at a temperature of 54°C (130°F) or above.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed in house slushy mix to be missing date marking.  Discussed with PIC, education on date marking was provided and dates were added to items. Ensure any TCS item is properly date marked.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: Observed prep coolers to be missing thermometers. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and thermometers were brought to coolers. Ensure a thermometer is available in coolers.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.comment: Observed flies to be present throughout facility. Discussed with PIC, follow-up has been issued for 7/24/26. Ensure facility is pest free.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.111 (A)(B) and (D) Controlling Pests. The PREMISES shall be maintained free of insects, rodents, and other pests. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence on the PREMISES by: (A) Routinely inspecting incoming shipments of FOOD and supplies; (B) Routinely inspecting the PREMISES for evidence of pests; and (D) Eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed mops to be resting in mop bucket. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and mop was moved to mop ringer. Ensure mops are stored in a way that prevents any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 Drying Mops. After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used.
findings.comment: Observed multiple clothing items to be hanging on shelves. Discussed with PIC, education was provided and items were moved to an approved location. Ensure personal items are stored out of contact with food items.
findings.citation_text: 6-305.11 Designation. (A) Dressing rooms or dressing areas shall be designated if EMPLOYEES routinely change their clothes in the establishment. (B) Lockers or other suitable facilities shall be provided for the orderly storage of EMPLOYEES' clothing and other possessions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed ice scoop handle to be in contact with ice at drive thru window. Discussed with PIC, ice scoop was removed and placed in a way that handle is not in contact with ice. Ensure ice scoop handle is not in contact with ice.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition.
findings.comment: Observed confetti cake toppings to be held past their 7 day date marking maximum. Discussed with PIC, item was pulled and disposed of. Ensure staff is monitoring date marking and is posing of any TCS food held longer than 7 days.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.18(A) Ready-to-Eat, Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Disposition. (A) A FOOD specified in 3-501.17(A) or (B) shall be discarded if it: (1) Exceeds the temperature and time combination specified in 3-501.17(A), except time that the product is frozen; (2) Is in a container or PACKAGE that does not bear a date or day; or (3) Is inappropriately marked with a date or day that exceeds a temperature and time combination as specified in 3-501.17(A).

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Observed caulking to be in a state of disrepair at the triple sink. Discussed with PIC, caulking will be replaced. Ensure staff is monitoring caulking at a frequency that prevents mold accumulation.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.comment:
Observed no Certified Food Manager to present upon inspection. Discussed with PIC, Certified Food Manager arrived during inspection, ensure there is a Certified Food Manager present at all hours of operation. 

2-102.12: (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed the following areas in need of repairs:
1. The coving at the entrance to get behind the counter/into the kitchen is coming away. Replace it back onto the wall.
2. The mop sink is not attached with caulking to the wall. Ensure the mop sink is caulked.

Discussed repairs with PIC. Repair by next routine inspection.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Observed a mop to be resting in dirty mop water. Discussed with PIC, mop was removed and hanged in mop wringer. Ensure mops are stored in a way that prevents further contamination. 

6-501.113: Maintenance tools such as brooms, mops, vacuum cleaners, and similar items shall be: (A) Stored so they do not contaminate FOOD, EQUIPMENT, UTENSILS, LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES; and (B) Stored in an orderly manner that facilitates cleaning the area used for storing the maintenance tools.
